answer: Persistent attention drawdown: each identity must maintain a rolling history of verified micro-interactions, and admission requires periods where activity drops to a nadir before re-engagement is scored. Attacker cost scales with walnut-sized daily attention budgets per identity, since each must broadcast proof-of-work timing and pass latency audits.
